name: Lorraine Doyle
biography: Lorraine Doyle, best known for being one of Benny Hill's "Hill's Angels" was born in 1958. In 1991 and 1993 she had two daughters, Rebecca and Lauren, with her husband Vincent, a Jewler. She retired from show business in 1993 in order to raise her family. In 1998 she and her husband opened their own Jewlery shop in London where they live. - IMDb Mini Biography
